description: L-BFGS-B minimization of the one-cycle failure rate from the analytical formula over the four free parameters, starting from the parameters of Ofek et al. and from random points.

free_parameters.g_GHz: coupling between the resonator and the ancilla (GHz)

settings.minimizer: L-BFGS-B, free parameters scaled to [0, 1] over their ranges, target in units of the failure rate at the parameters of Ofek et al.
